blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Depyrogenation (除熱原)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: Pyrogen（熱原）：任何能引起人體發熱反應（pyrexia）的物質。在注射製劑中，最重要的熱原是革蘭氏陰性菌的外膜成分——細菌內毒素（Bacterial Endotoxin）。
blocks.en: Pyrogen: Any substance that can cause a febrile response (pyrexia) in humans. In injectable products, the most important pyrogen is bacterial endotoxin, a component of the outer membrane of Gram-negative bacteria.

blocks.zh: Depyrogenation（除熱原）：USP 的定義非常精確——「直接且經驗證的熱原破壞或去除」。注意這裡有兩個關鍵詞：(1) 直接（direct）——指針對內毒素本身的措施，而非間接預防；(2) 驗證（validated）——必須有書面驗證證明有效。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: The USP definition is very precise: "the direct and validated destruction or removal of pyrogens." Note the two key words: (1) direct, meaning a measure aimed at the endotoxin itself rather than indirect prevention; and (2) validated, meaning there must be written validation demonstrating that it is effective.

blocks.zh: 〈1228〉 系列架構：本章是母章，後續子章包括 〈1228.1〉乾熱除熱原、〈1228.2〉過濾、〈1228.3〉液態製劑除熱原等，各自針對不同製程。
blocks.en: Structure of the <1228> series: This chapter is the parent chapter. The subchapters that follow include <1228.1> Dry Heat Depyrogenation, <1228.2> Filtration, and <1228.3> Depyrogenation of Liquid Products, each addressing a different process.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像注射製劑的生產就像製作靜脈點滴的生理食鹽水。即使你用最嚴格的方式過濾、滅菌，確保瓶內沒有任何活菌，但如果原料水曾經被革蘭氏陰性菌污染過，菌體死後留下的細胞壁碎片（內毒素）仍然存在——它們非常耐熱，普通高壓滅菌殺不死它們。病人輸液後可能立即發高燒，甚至休克。除熱原就是要把這些「死菌的毒素殘骸」清除乾淨。
blocks.en: Think of making saline for an intravenous drip. Even if you filter and sterilize in the strictest way and make sure there are no living bacteria in the bottle, if the source water was ever contaminated with Gram-negative bacteria, the cell wall fragments (endotoxin) left behind when the cells die are still there. They are very heat-resistant, and ordinary autoclaving cannot destroy them. After the infusion, the patient may develop a high fever immediately, or even go into shock. Depyrogenation is about clearing away these "toxic remains of dead bacteria."

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌 ≠ 無熱原
blocks.en: Key Point: Sterile ≠ Pyrogen-Free

blocks.zh: 這是初學者最常犯的認知錯誤！無菌（Sterile）代表沒有活的微生物；無熱原（Pyrogen-free）代表沒有能引起發熱反應的物質。
blocks.en: This is the mistake beginners make most often. Sterile means there are no living microorganisms; pyrogen-free means there are no substances that can cause a febrile response.

blocks.zh: 一個製劑可以無菌但仍含有大量內毒素（因為死菌的細胞壁殘留）；反之，在某些特殊場景下也可能無內毒素但有其他熱原。這也是為什麼注射製劑必須同時符合兩個標準：Sterility Test〈71〉 AND Bacterial Endotoxins Test〈85〉。
blocks.en: A product can be sterile and still contain a large amount of endotoxin (because cell wall remnants of dead bacteria remain). Conversely, in some special situations a product may be free of endotoxin but still contain other pyrogens. This is why an injectable product must meet two standards at the same time: Sterility Test <71> AND Bacterial Endotoxins Test <85>.

blocks.zh: 法規視角 — HACCP 在製藥中的應用
blocks.en: Regulatory Perspective: HACCP in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

blocks.zh: HACCP（危害分析與關鍵控制點）原本是食品安全工具，現已被製藥業廣泛採用。USP〈1228〉明確提到用 HACCP 來識別製程中的 CCP（Critical Control Points，關鍵控制點）——例如原料水系統、設備清洗步驟、原料驗收等。這與 ICH Q9 品質風險管理（Quality Risk Management）的理念完全一致。
blocks.en: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) was originally a food safety tool and is now widely adopted in the pharmaceutical industry. USP <1228> explicitly mentions using HACCP to identify the CCPs (Critical Control Points) in a process, for example the source water system, equipment cleaning steps, and incoming material acceptance. This is fully consistent with the philosophy of ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個注射製劑通過了無菌試驗（Sterility Test〈71〉），是否可以確保它對病人是安全的？請從熱原角度說明。
blocks.en: An injectable product has passed the Sterility Test <71>. Does that ensure it is safe for the patient? Explain from the pyrogen perspective.

blocks.zh: USP 為什麼在 〈1228〉 的定義中強調「validated（驗證的）」這個詞？沒有驗證的除熱原步驟有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does USP stress the word "validated" in the <1228> definition? What are the risks of a depyrogenation step that has not been validated?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 廠正在開發一個新的注射用抗體藥物，請舉出至少 3 個可能引入內毒素的「關鍵控制點（CCP）」。
blocks.en: Your CDMO site is developing a new injectable antibody drug. Name at least 3 critical control points (CCPs) where endotoxin could be introduced.

blocks.zh: 0.2 Bacterial Endotoxin and Lipopolysaccharide | 細菌內毒素與脂多糖
blocks.en: 0.2 Bacterial Endotoxin and Lipopolysaccharide

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — LPS 的三區段結構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three-Region Structure of LPS

blocks.zh: 這是理解除熱原科學的基礎。LPS 由三個功能不同的區段組成：
blocks.en: This is the foundation for understanding the science of depyrogenation. LPS is made up of three regions with different functions:

blocks.zh: Lipid A（脂質 A）：藏在分子深處的疏水性錨點。這是內毒素毒性的核心——幾乎所有革蘭氏陰性菌的 Lipid A 結構都高度相似（conserved），這也是 BET（鱟試劑法）能廣泛檢測各種內毒素的原因。
blocks.en: Lipid A: The hydrophobic anchor buried deep in the molecule. It is the core of endotoxin toxicity. The Lipid A structure is highly similar (conserved) across almost all Gram-negative bacteria, which is why the BET (the Limulus amebocyte lysate method) can detect such a wide range of endotoxins.

blocks.zh: Core Oligosaccharide（核心寡糖）：連接 Lipid A 和外層 O-抗原的橋樑，結構相對保守。
blocks.en: Core Oligosaccharide: The bridge connecting Lipid A to the outer O-antigen. Its structure is relatively conserved.

blocks.zh: O-Antigen（O 抗原）：外層的親水性多糖鏈，結構因菌株而異（variable）。它讓不同菌株有不同的「血清型（serotype）」，是細菌分類鑑定的依據。
blocks.en: O-Antigen: The hydrophilic polysaccharide chain on the outside, whose structure varies (variable) from strain to strain. It gives different strains different "serotypes" and is the basis for bacterial classification and identification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — LPS 的兩親性
blocks.en: Analogy: The Amphipathic Nature of LPS

blocks.zh: LPS 分子就像清潔劑（洗碗精）分子：一頭親水（O-抗原）、一頭親油（Lipid A）。這種兩親性（Amphipathic）使 LPS 在水溶液中會自動聚集，形成膠束（micelles）、雙層膜（bilayers）等各種結構——就像洗碗精在水中形成泡泡一樣。這種聚集行為使得 LPS 的有效濃度和生物活性難以預測，也讓除熱原驗證更複雜。
blocks.en: An LPS molecule is like a detergent (dish soap) molecule: one end is water-loving (O-antigen) and the other is oil-loving (Lipid A). This amphipathic property makes LPS aggregate spontaneously in aqueous solution, forming micelles, bilayers, and other structures, much as dish soap forms bubbles in water. This aggregation makes the effective concentration and biological activity of LPS hard to predict and makes depyrogenation validation more complicated.

blocks.zh: 更麻煩的是，LPS 的疏水端（Lipid A）會「黏」在玻璃瓶、塑膠管路的表面——就像油脂沾在鍋底很難洗掉。這直接影響驗證研究中挑戰材料的回收率（recovery）。
blocks.en: What makes it worse is that the hydrophobic end of LPS (Lipid A) "sticks" to the surfaces of glass vials and plastic tubing, like grease on the bottom of a pan that is hard to wash off. This directly affects the recovery of the challenge material in validation studies.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語比較 — Native Endotoxin vs. Purified LPS
blocks.en: Key Terms Compared: Native Endotoxin vs. Purified LPS

blocks.zh:
特性比較：
┌─────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
│ 特性            │ Purified LPS     │ Native Endotoxin │
├─────────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│ 組成            │ 純化脂多糖       │ 細菌細胞壁碎片   │
│ 聚集/吸附問題   │ 嚴重（高）       │ 較少（低）       │
│ 反映現實狀況    │ 較差             │ 較好             │
│ 標準化程度      │ 高（RSE/CSE）    │ 低（批次差異大） │
│ 適用場景        │ 常規 BET 校正    │ 複雜基質驗證研究 │
└─────────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┘

RSE = Reference Standard Endotoxin（參考標準內毒素）
CSE = Control Standard Endotoxin（控制標準內毒素）
blocks.en:
Comparison of characteristics:
┌─────────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
│ Characteristic      │ Purified LPS     │ Native Endotoxin │
├─────────────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│ Composition         │ Purified LPS     │ Bacterial cell   │
│                     │                  │ wall fragments   │
│ Aggregation/        │ Severe (high)    │ Less (low)       │
│ adsorption problems │                  │                  │
│ Reflects real-world │ Poor             │ Better           │
│ conditions          │                  │                  │
│ Degree of           │ High (RSE/CSE)   │ Low (large       │
│ standardization     │                  │ batch variation) │
│ Suitable use        │ Routine BET      │ Validation       │
│                     │ calibration      │ studies in       │
│                     │                  │ complex matrices │
└─────────────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┘

RSE = Reference Standard Endotoxin
CSE = Control Standard Endotoxin

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 挑戰材料選擇對驗證結果的影響
blocks.en: Key Point: How the Choice of Challenge Material Affects Validation Results

blocks.zh: USP 在這裡提出一個重要的科學觀點：對於複雜基質（如發酵液、含蛋白質的製劑）或特殊表面材料，使用純化 LPS 做驗證挑戰材料可能不能代表真實情況。
blocks.en: USP makes an important scientific point here: for complex matrices (such as fermentation broths and protein-containing products) or special surface materials, using purified LPS as the validation challenge material may not be representative of the real situation.

blocks.zh:
純化 LPS 在複雜環境下的聚集和吸附行為與天然內毒素截然不同，可能導致：
(1) 挑戰材料回收率偏低，讓除熱原看起來比實際更有效（假陰性風險）
(2) 結果重現性差，批次間差異大
blocks.en:
In a complex environment, the aggregation and adsorption behavior of purified LPS is quite different from that of native endotoxin, which can lead to:
(1) low recovery of the challenge material, making depyrogenation look more effective than it really is (risk of a false negative)
(2) poor reproducibility, with large batch-to-batch differences

blocks.zh: 因此，USP 允許使用 native endotoxin 作為挑戰材料，特別是在產品流（product stream）的除熱原驗證中。
blocks.en: Therefore, USP allows the use of native endotoxin as the challenge material, especially for depyrogenation validation of the product stream.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 場景
blocks.en: Practical Application: The CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 承接新客戶的除熱原驗證時，你必須問客戶：「你的製劑基質是什麼？pH？是否含有螯合劑（chelating agents）如 EDTA？是否含有界面活性劑（surfactants）？」——因為這些因素都會影響 LPS 的聚集狀態，進而影響 BET〈85〉的結果和除熱原驗證的設計。不同的製劑基質，可能需要不同的方法驗證（method suitability）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on depyrogenation validation for a new client, you must ask the client: "What is your product matrix? What is the pH? Does it contain chelating agents such as EDTA? Does it contain surfactants?" All of these factors affect the aggregation state of LPS and therefore the BET <85> results and the design of the depyrogenation validation. Different product matrices may require different method validations (method suitability).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Lipid A 的結構在各種革蘭氏陰性菌之間高度保守（conserved）？這個特性對 BET 試驗有什麼實際意義？
blocks.en: Why is the Lipid A structure so highly conserved across Gram-negative bacteria? What practical significance does this have for the BET?

blocks.zh: 你的玻璃瓶除熱原驗證使用純化 LPS 做挑戰材料，結果顯示 4-log reduction。但你知道玻璃瓶表面對 LPS 有很強的吸附。請問這個 4-log reduction 的數字是否可信？可能偏高還是偏低？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your glass vial depyrogenation validation used purified LPS as the challenge material and showed a 4-log reduction. But you know that glass surfaces adsorb LPS strongly. Is this 4-log reduction figure credible? Is it likely to be too high or too low, and why?

blocks.zh: 某個含有 EDTA 螯合劑的眼用注射製劑，在做 BET〈85〉時遇到干擾（interference）。請問可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: An ophthalmic injectable product containing the chelating agent EDTA encounters interference during BET <85>. What could be the possible causes?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 除熱原（Depyrogenation）是注射製劑生產的必要步驟，與無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）同等重要，但針對完全不同的危害——內毒素（死菌殘留的細胞壁碎片）。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation is an essential step in injectable manufacturing. It is as important as sterility assurance but addresses an entirely different hazard: endotoxin (cell wall fragments left by dead bacteria).

blocks.zh: LPS 的三區段結構決定了其生物活性（Lipid A 負責毒性）和物理化學行為（兩親性導致聚集與吸附），這直接影響除熱原方法的設計和驗證。
blocks.en: The three-region structure of LPS determines its biological activity (Lipid A is responsible for toxicity) and its physicochemical behavior (amphipathicity leads to aggregation and adsorption), which directly affects the design and validation of depyrogenation methods.

blocks.zh: Native Endotoxin vs. Purified LPS——在複雜基質或特殊表面材料的驗證研究中，天然內毒素可能比純化 LPS 更能反映實際操作現實。
blocks.en: Native Endotoxin vs. Purified LPS: In validation studies involving complex matrices or special surface materials, native endotoxin may reflect real operating conditions better than purified LPS.

blocks.zh: 現代哲學：〈1228〉系列採用 QbD 和風險管理（HACCP、CCP）的思維，從「3-log reduction」的教條式標準轉向基於製程理解的科學驗證方法。
blocks.en: Modern philosophy: The <1228> series adopts QbD and risk management thinking (HACCP, CCP), moving from the dogmatic "3-log reduction" standard to a scientific validation approach based on process understanding.
